title: US Packaging EPR Eco-modulation: Three States, Three Very Different Approaches
heroIntroduction: Eco-modulation is where packaging EPR moves from compliance to strategy. In the US, the first three states to begin their packaging EPR programmes – California, Colorado and Oregon – have each taken a distinct route.
excerpt: Eco-modulation is where packaging EPR moves from compliance to strategy. Instead of every producer paying the same rate per pound of a given material, fees are adjusted to reward better packaging design and sustainability.
seoTitle: US Packaging EPR Eco-modulation: California, Colorado and Oregon
seoDescription: How California, Colorado and Oregon use eco-modulation to adjust packaging EPR fees: California's SRIM, Colorado's fee factors and Oregon's LCA bonuses.
